card.name: Articles before a noun in old narrative
card.fires_on: Small determiners such as the, a, an, this, any and some, plus a few adjectives, that come right before an expected noun. The setting is older historical or textbook prose about battles, politics or anatomy.

modes.label: War and politics
modes.description: A determiner or adjective just before a noun like battle, fire or calamity in 19th-century war and political narrative.

modes.description: A determiner or modifier before a noun in an old physiology or anatomy passage.
modes.example: with the least<< possible>> amount of friction
